title: Split one axis through the section polynomial at ceiling 9 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

On one axis,

```text
B - C = (B - P) + (P - C).
```

If both pieces are strictly below `ε`, then `||B - C|| < 2 ε`. If `||B|| ≤ 9 p^2` and `||P - B|| < ε`, then `||P|| < 9 p^2 + ε`. The integer shadow uses ceiling `9` and error `2`: `|10| ≤ 9 + 2` while `|10| > 9`, and `|12| > 9 + 1`.

The ceiling `||B|| ≤ 9 p^2` and each section error stay hypotheses. The factor 2 is the sum of the two errors. HALO's `2g` rectangles stay a volume partition. No new κ. The selected record remains `23/10000`.

This answers the open question of #4508 for the difference and the approximant norm. It does not replay #4508. #4490 is the same split at ceiling `10 p^2`. Which hypothesis a core row past `ceil(p^{48})` inherits is left open.

- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run
